design.notes: Corrupt file: the repair quote PDF keeps only the first 40 % of its bytes.

triage.rationale: The glazier's quote file is cut off and cannot be opened, so the required repair quote is unreadable and someone must obtain a working copy (evidence_outstanding). The claimant can state the total (NZD 1,495.00 including GST) but only if asked, so whether an amount is known is left open (amount_over_threshold_or_unknown allowed). The photo, the glazier's attendance note and the Police record are readable. The window is boarded, the home habitable, nobody is hurt and no other party is involved. Main's theft branch also lists proof of ownership; nothing was taken and the claim is for the building, so the pack treats the photo, the repair quote and the Police record as the required materials. Coverage is not unclear: the pack policy carries no uncertainty marker in the lookup, and coverage = review_required on its own does not count (maintainer, 2026-09-30). The pack policy must be in the lookup (setup.policies_in_system).

ownership_doc_after_loss.basis: No receipt, proof of purchase or proof of ownership in the pack; nothing was taken

quote_before_loss.basis: The only quote file is truncated and cannot be opened, so its date cannot be read (rules, section 3: an unreadable date is not checked).

policy_inception_30d.basis: The lookup holds only the current period start (15 May 2026), which changes at every renewal, so the system cannot see how new the policy is; today it is not checked. The original inception date in the pack design, 2022-05-15, is more than 30 days before the incident, so the rule would give clear.

The Agent tells the claimant that the glazier's quote file could not be opened or read, and asks for it to be sent again or says it can be sent later.

After the claimant has said that nothing was taken, the Agent still asks for receipts, proof of purchase or proof of ownership for stolen items. Asking once whether anything was taken is fine.
